Hi Lydia —

Great to connect — appreciate the clear asks. High-level notes below; I attached a spreadsheet with a couple of sizing scenarios and a short MAP draft.

Sizing / headroom guidance (quick):
- Baseline committed slab: size to cover 95th percentile sustained token throughput for your expected production traffic.
- Short-term headroom: +20% on baseline for expected daily variance (recommended for first 90 days).
- Burst runway: additional ephemeral capacity for transient spikes (we size based on P95->P99 traffic delta; see attached sheet).

Autoscale & fallback mechanics:
- Primary: Dedicated slab services live traffic up to capacity.
- Ephemeral burst: requests above slab are routed to transient pool where we apply preemptible instances (lower-cost, lower-priority).
- Fallback order: (1) reserved slab, (2) ephemeral burst (preemptible), (3) hosted API fallback if configured.

Crediting & SLOs:
- If we evict preemptible workloads or route to hosted fallback > X minutes in a rolling 24h window, we credit agreed burst minutes per the MAP.
- Suggested: 1 hour/month of complimentary burst credit during ramp; tiered credits if sustained evictions occur.

I've attached: "burst-forecast-v1.xlsx" (scenarios), and draft MAP: "MAP_draft.pdf". Marcus is copied with ops details — Marcus, anything to add on eviction windows or runbook triggers?

Happy to run through the spreadsheet on a call — does next Tue 2/17 10am PT work?

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — quick ops add from my side.

Eviction & throttle rules (ops perspective):
- Eviction tolerance window: preemptible instances have soft eviction warnings at 2 min and hard eviction at 30s. We schedule graceful trickle-off for long-running generations.
- Throttle policy: requests hitting burst pool are prioritized by token budget per-request; we surface 429 with Retry-After when burst capacity is saturated.
- Credit math (example): if Skybridge experiences > 120 total preemptible evictions in a 7-day rolling window we trigger an SLA review and issue credit of X token-hours per the MAP. See short note I uploaded: "eviction-math-notes.txt" (attached).

Runbook pointers I've added to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Skybridge-Runbook — includes escalation contacts, telemetry dashboards, and a playbook for scheduled pre-warm windows.

Marcus
Director, Production Reliability
Redwood Inference

I'll loop in our security PO when you confirm you want that route enabled; otherwise assume preemptible-only fallback with no cross-tenant token caching.
